contests.title: Proposition 429: Tanque Verde Unified School District budget override continuation
contests.scopeNote: Voters of Tanque Verde Unified School District No. 13.

measures.questionText:
Shall the Governing Board of Tanque Verde Unified School District No. 13 of Pima County, Arizona (the
“District”), adopt a General Maintenance and Operation Budget that includes an amount that exceeds
the revenue control limit specified by statute by 15% for fiscal year 2027/2028 and for six (6) subsequent
years as described below? The fiscal year 2027/2028 budget override authority represents an extension
of the existing budget override authority which is scheduled to phase down by one-third for fiscal year
2028/2029 and another one-third in fiscal year 2029/2030 and will terminate for fiscal year 2030/2031 if
the voters do not approve the override.

The amount of the proposed continuation of the budget increase of the proposed budget over the
alternate budget for fiscal year 2027/2028 is estimated to be $-0-. In fiscal years 2027/2028 through
2031/2032 the amount of the proposed increase will be 15% of the District’s revenue control limit in each
of such years, as provided in Section 15-481(P) of the Arizona Revised Statutes. In fiscal years 2032/2033
and 2033/2034, the amount of the proposed increase will be 10% and 5%, respectively, of the District’s
revenue control limit in each of such years, as provided in Section 15-481(P) of the Arizona Revised
Statutes.
Any budget increase continuation authorized by this election shall be entirely funded
by a levy of taxes on the taxable property in this school district for the year for which
adopted and for six (6) subsequent years, shall not be realized from monies furnished
by the state and shall not be subject to the limitation on taxes specified in Article IX,
Section 18, Constitution of Arizona. Based on the current net assessed valuation used for
secondary property tax purposes, to fund the proposed continuation of the increase in
the school district’s budget would require an estimated continuation of a tax rate of $0.88
per one hundred dollars of assessed valuation used for secondary property tax purposes
and is in addition to the school district’s tax rate that will be levied to fund the school
district’s revenue control limit allowed by law.

voterGuide.summary:
TANQUE VERDE UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT NO. 13
NOVEMBER 3, 2026

15% MAINTENANCE AND OPERATION BUDGET OVERRIDE INFORMATION
A STATEMENT AS TO WHY THE 15% MAINTENANCE AND OPERATION
BUDGET OVERRIDE ELECTION HAS BEEN CALLED

The Governing Board of the District has called a special budget override election to be
held on November 3, 2026 to request voter authorization to exceed the Maintenance
and Operation Budget Limit by 15% of the revenue control limit to fund existing
programs, such budget override to be in effect for a period of seven (7) years. The
override authorized by this election shall be funded from a levy of taxes on the taxable
property within the District. The proposed override is a continuation of the existing
15% override.
With voter approval to continue the override, it is estimated that the total amount of
the override for fiscal year 2027/2028 will be $2,378,902. If the override is not approved,
the existing 15% override will phase out by reducing by one-third in 2028/2029 and
another one-third in fiscal year 2029/2030. The estimated secondary tax rate needed
to fund the full override is $0.88 per one hundred dollars of net assessed valuation for
secondary tax purposes. The estimated secondary tax rate for the proposed override is
approximately equal to the existing secondary tax rate for the current override, as this
override will maintain programs that have been in place with the prior year’s override
approvals.
The estimated continuation cost to an owner of a home with a limited property value
of $519,240 (the average value of a home in the District) would be approximately $459
per year.
The 15% Maintenance and Operation budget override would continue funding for
programs currently serving District students. This override supports the District’s
efforts to help maintain present levels of service:
•   Career and technical education (CTE) classes
•   Elementary STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, Mathematics)
•   Elementary Physical Education (PE)
•   Advanced placement / Dual enrollment classes
•   Music and Art programs
•   Libraries

Purposes:



(1) The 15% maintenance and operation override authorization is a continuation of the existing 15% maintenance
and operation override authorized by the voters on 11/8/2022. If the override is not approved, the existing 15%
maintenance and operation override will phase out by reducing one-third in fiscal year 2028/2029 and another
one-third in fiscal year 2029/2030. The proposed and alternate 2027/2028 budgets represent the District’s best
estimate based on various assumptions relating to student growth and other factors affecting revenues and
expenditures. In adopting such alternate budget, the Governing Board shall follow the procedures prescribed
in A.R.S. Section 15-905 for adopting a budget that does not include any proposed increases not approved at an
election, except for increases levied to meet a desegregation order, if applicable.
(2) Current net assessed valuation for secondary property tax purposes is the 2026/2027 preliminary value provided
by the Arizona Department of Revenue.
(3) Estimated by Arizona Department of Revenue based on preliminary 2026/2027 net assessed valuation.
(4) Per one hundred dollars of net assessed valuation used for secondary property tax purposes.
voterGuide.passageThreshold: A. If a proposed budget of a school district exceeds the aggregate budget limit for the budget year, at least ninety days before the proposed election the governing board shall order an override election to be held on the first Tuesday following the first Monday in November as prescribed by section 16-204, subsection F for the purpose of presenting the proposed budget to the qualified electors of the school district who by a majority of those voting either shall affirm or reject the budget.
argumentsFor:
Tanque Verde Unified School District is recognized as one of the premier school districts
in Arizona. The many accomplishments earned by our students and staff in academics,
athletics, and extracurricular activities are a direct reflection of this community’s longstanding
commitment to education through continued voter support of past budget continuations.
The District’s success strengthens property values and helps ensure our graduates are civic-
minded, capable, and prepared to contribute positively to society.
Your YES vote on this budget continuation will NOT increase your property tax rate. This
measure continues the current level of funding already in place. Continued funding is
essential to maintaining the programs our community values most and that have contributed
to our schools’ exceptional success.
This budget continuation supports Advanced Placement (AP), Career & Technical Education
(CTE), STEAM programs, Performing and Visual Arts, Physical Education, Libraries, Nurses,
and Gifted Programs.
Without sufficient voter support, these programs and services could face significant reductions
or possible elimination.
We strongly encourage our community to vote YES to approve the budget continuation and
help preserve the high level of educational excellence that benefits our students, schools, and
community.
Please vote YES on November 3rd.

Governing Board for Tanque Verde Unified School District

The quality of our school district and the efficient management of the district budget are
important to me as a local business owner and job creator. By utilizing its resources wisely,
the Tanque Verde Unified School District demonstrates that it serves as a financial steward.
No matter their frugal practices, the allocated resources are limited. The district does not have
the benefit of a large commercial tax base nor does it qualify for many federal program dollars.
And, at 48th in the nation, Arizona does not provide sufficient, consistent funding to our
public schools.
Our schools need our continued community support. We can ensure our local schools remain
high quality by continuing the current budget override. All funds from the TVUSD M&O
Override remain in our community, directly supporting our schools and our students, with
the benefit of supporting a dynamic community. I am confident that my tax dollars are being
utilized efficiently and effectively, and I approve of the district budget override.
I support our local schools because I believe they are excelling in the business of educating
our students. I urge you to vote YES to continue the TVUSD M&O Budget Override.
Carlos Ruiz, President
Cindy Ruiz, Vice President

HT Metals
Tucson, AZ

As the proud principal of Tanque Verde High School: the highest-performing traditional public
high school in Arizona, and as a proud neighbor who also calls this community home, I see
every day what your investment in our schools makes possible.
I watch our students earn prestigious scholarships to universities across the country. I also
watch students leave our campus with industry certifications, technical skills, and high-
paying job offers in the trades. Every one of those success stories begins with a community
that believes in its children.
Proposition 429 is not a new tax. It simply continues the local funding our community
has supported for years to protect the opportunities that help our students thrive: excellent
teachers, smaller class sizes, career and technical education, advanced academics, the arts,
and so much more.
Whether our graduates become engineers, teachers, doctors, welders, electricians, business
owners, or military leaders, they are the future of Tanque Verde. Investing in them strengthens
our workforce, our economy, and the community we all love.
As both your principal and your neighbor, I respectfully ask you to join me in voting YES on
Proposition 429.
Amy Cislak
Principal, Tanque Verde High School
Tucson, AZ

This November, you are being asked to vote YES on Proposition 429, an override measure that
will continue to support the students in the Tanque Verde Unified School District (TVUSD).
The override is not a tax increase, it is a continuation of the local funding that has been in
place since 2014.
As a former TVUSD Governing Board member for almost eight years, I can attest to the
importance of the override funding. All four TVUSD schools offer art, music, physical
education, library and health services with the support of override dollars. And as a parent of
three children in the District, I know these programs help to provide a well rounded educational
experience for our students. In addition, these programs increase the property values within
the District, and make Tanque Verde a very desirable location in which to reside. Without the
continuation of the override, TVUSD will be forced to phase out these programs.
I cannot overstate the importance of the District’s override funds, and I ask for your support by
voting YES on Proposition 429, the continuation of the TVUSD override.
Susan Fry
Director, SPF Consulting
Tucson, AZ

We love our Tanque Verde community! We love our Tanque Verde School District! We are so
grateful that we had the opportunity to raise our children in this wonderful place. Dedicated
district leadership and staff have helped propel countless students further down the road to
becoming productive and optimistic adults...Adults that make the world a better and brighter
place!!!

We believe in and have seen the value of a well rounded education and its impact on individuals,
families and communities. In fact, this is why we continue to volunteer in this great school
district. Excellence in education is part of the Tanque Verde tradition and history. Our schools
are among the very best in the State of Arizona! And this in turn, makes our community a
GREAT place to raise children and a GREAT place to enjoy retirement.

We have the opportunity to continue to be part of this excellence by voting YES for the TVUSD
Maintenance & Operations Override. We invite you to vote with us, and many others, to help
keep our vibrant community moving forward on November 3rd, 2026.

Steve and Carol Langford
Tucson, AZ

The Tanque Verde Education Alliance is a coalition of community leaders, long-time residents,
business owners, and parents formed to support our A-rated Tanque Verde Unified School
District.
We recognize that our community is one of the most unique and desirable places to live in
the entire state. One of the key reasons we enjoy such a special community is because of
our commitment to our local schools. High-performing schools play an important role in
protecting our property values and reducing crime.
This November, voters will have a chance to support our schools by voting YES on the budget
continuation. This funding is used to invest in smaller class sizes, teacher salaries, career and
technical education, STEAM, physical education, school nurses, and much more. We ask you
to join us in voting YES on the budget continuation to:
•   Protect our quality of life
•   Attract and retain our best teachers
•   Invest in building our future workforce and student success
The override is not a tax increase – it is a continuation of the local funding that has been in
place since 2014. This is our opportunity to continue to invest in our schools and protect our
quality of life. Learn more at www.tvedalliance.org.
Anne Velosa, Chair
Tanque Verde Education Alliance
Tucson, AZ

We proudly support the Tanque Verde Unified School District override because we have
experienced firsthand the incredible opportunities this district provides. We have lived in the
district for 16 years, and three of our four children graduated from Tanque Verde High School.
Our children benefited from outstanding teachers, rigorous Honors and AP courses, Career
and Technical Education, athletics, and an exceptional Agricultural Education/FFA program
that prepared them for college, careers, and lifelong success. When one of our children needed
learning accommodations, the teachers and administrators partnered closely with our family
to ensure they received the support needed to thrive.
What makes Tanque Verde exceptional is its commitment to every student. Educators know
their students, hold them to high expectations, and provide the support each child needs to
succeed. The district’s investment in STEM, Career and Technical Education, and rigorous
academic programs opens doors for students while preserving the close-knit, student-
centered community that makes Tanque Verde so special.
Continuing this override will help retain outstanding teachers and sustain the high-quality
programs that have positively impacted our family and countless others. We encourage our
neighbors to vote YES.
Robert & Sara Torres
Community Members
Tucson, AZ

I am a retired financial executive and farmer who supports the Tanque Verde Unified School
District override. I don’t have kids in our schools anymore, but I recognize the key role that
quality education plays in supporting the community and the students who live here.

So frequently when speaking with people who are considering our community for employment
or call it home, the question of the quality of schools is raised. The value of our homes and the
development of business are linked directly to the quality of our schools.

As retirees, we need quality services, and we want to maintain the value of our homes. The
override will help us on both counts.

The override will support programs that are essential to the education of our community’s
next generation of leaders who will help boost our economy and development.

Tanque Verde has made great strides over the past several years with high student college
enrollment and excellent placement in vocational colleges. For the health, long-term success,
and future of our community, please vote yes on Proposition 429 to continue the override.

Rocky Ferrell
Retired Financial Executive and Farmer
Tucson, AZ

Strong schools build strong communities, and the Tanque Verde Unified School District is an
essential part of what makes our community such a desirable place to live, work, and raise a
family.

The TVES Parent Teacher Group strongly supports the renewal of the Maintenance and
Operations override. This funding helps the district attract and retain outstanding teachers
and staff while supporting smaller class sizes, Career and Technical Education, elementary
STEAM and physical education, school nurses, librarians, music, art, gifted education, and
other programs that give students a well-rounded, high-quality education.

Our PTG, families, teachers, staff, and broader school community work tirelessly—often in
addition to their own full-time jobs and family responsibilities—to raise funds that help offset
district funding shortages and supplement important student programs. We are proud of
what our community accomplishes, but volunteer fundraising cannot replace stable, reliable
funding for essential staff and educational opportunities.

The override is a continuation of local funding that has been in place since 2014, not a new
tax increase. We strongly encourage our community to vote Yes and continue investing in
student success, excellent schools, and Tanque Verde’s future.

Tina Catalina
TVES PTG President
Tucson, AZ

Andrea Hafner
TVES PTG Treasurer
Tucson, AZ

In 2009, our family moved so that our children could attend the schools in the Tanque Verde
Unified School District due to their excellent reputation. Over the sixteen years our children
were students in Tanque Verde schools, they had the benefit of engaging in various classroom
experiences like
•   Elementary Physical Education and Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and
Mathematics (STEAM)
•   Marching, Concert, and Jazz bands
•   Mock Trial and Sports Med
•   Advanced Placement classes in Earth Science, US History, Government, Calculus,
English Literature, English Language, and Spanish
•   Dual Enrollment classes in Writing and Chemistry

Our children’s teachers not only supported our children’s learning through these courses, but
they also celebrated all their students’ growth in the classroom and during extra-curricular
activities.
Our three children have now graduated from Tanque Verde schools, schools which prepared
them for their next educational and occupational opportunities.
In turn, I support TVUSD’s continued efforts to educate a quality, competitive workforce
to support our area’s long-term success. By voting yes on Proposition 429, I support the
continuation of local funding which supports the critical programs above. I invite you to join
me in voting yes on Proposition 429.
Alfonso Velosa III
Parent
Tucson, AZ

measureRecords.yesMeans:
A “yes” vote shall authorize the Tanque Verde Unified School District No. 13 School District Governing Board to
continue the existing maintenance and operation budget override authority and resulting tax, which includes an
amount that exceeds the District’s revenue control limit.
measureRecords.noMeans:
A “no” vote shall not authorize the Tanque Verde Unified School District No. 13 School District Governing Board to
extend the existing maintenance and operation budget override authority and resulting tax.
